study type: Secondary analysis of a nationwide cross-sectional study
exposure: Women who had a caesarean section
Women who had an emergency caesarean section
cohort: All women giving birth in 54 referral-level hospitals in Nigeria between September 1, 2019 and August 31, 2020
finding: The overall caesarean section rate was 33.3%, with the majority being emergency cases, and maternal mortality was associated with being younger than 20 or older than 35 years, having lower education levels, and being referred from another facility or informal setting.
